name: Vytautas Magnus University
summary: Liberal-arts university in Kaunas with 16 English-taught bachelor's across social sciences, informatics, sciences, business and music.

ib.text: Upload your IB diploma and results (60% average minimum); English at B2 is shown by test or by a school letter that your education was in English. Motivation letter; a maths test or interview may follow.

programmes.name: Economics and Finance
programmes.about: Three-year business economics degree taught entirely in English: economics and finance with computational thinking, teamwork, an internship and a behavioural economics lab.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is your school-grade average 70% plus motivation letter or interview 30%; at least 60% overall average to apply.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: Entrepreneurial leadership and management: how businesses and organisations work, for future managers, consultants and business owners.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is your school-grade average 70% plus motivation letter or interview 30%; at least 60% overall average to apply.

programmes.name: Logistics and Commerce
programmes.about: Smart, sustainable logistics operations, sales techniques, IT in commerce and building your own e-business.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, English 40% and motivation letter or interview 20%.

programmes.name: Sustainable Bio-Business Management
programmes.about: Management, economics and technology for the bioeconomy: running and developing organisations in a changing labour market.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, English 40% and motivation letter or interview 20%.

programmes.name: Political Studies: World Politics and Economy
programmes.about: Global politics, international relations, political economy, economic diplomacy and trade, through topics such as migration, climate change and geopolitics; taught in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is a history, geography, economics or IT grade 30%, English 30%, motivation letter 30% and maths 10%.

family.name: Political Studies
family.differs: Focus on global politics, international political economy and trade.
family.cardLine: Global politics, political economy and trade

programmes.name: Political Studies: International Politics and Development Studies
programmes.about: Developing regions, international processes, human rights, migration and development strategy, preparing political analysts who compare and explain political and economic change.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is a history, geography, economics or IT grade 30%, English 30%, motivation letter 30% and maths 10%.

family.name: Political Studies
family.differs: Focus on developing regions, human rights and development strategy.

programmes.name: Sociology and Anthropology: Society, Culture and Communication
programmes.about: Sociology with a communication specialisation: researching and forecasting social processes and communicating them to the public, taught in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is history 40%, maths 40% and English 20%.

programmes.name: English Philology
programmes.about: English linguistics, discourse and philology for careers in teaching, translation, computational linguistics and media; taught entirely in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is your average of school exams 80% plus an English grade 20% (B2 minimum).

needs.note: B2 minimum; counts 20% of the score

programmes.name: Biology and Genetics
programmes.about: Biology foundations and genetics, for careers in biotechnology, biopharmaceutics, the food industry and environmental protection.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is English 20%, maths 20%, biology or chemistry 30% and motivation letter 30%. Some places are state-funded.

programmes.name: Biotechnology
programmes.about: Laboratory work and data analysis with modern methods, plus IT skills to develop biotechnology products for pharmaceutics, environment and industry.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is English 20%, maths 20%, biology or chemistry 30% and motivation letter 30%. Some places are state-funded.

programmes.name: Informatics Systems
programmes.about: Information systems and networks, programming, data analysis and visualisation, with specialisations in software systems, AI systems or business informatics.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, English 30% and motivation letter 30%.

programmes.name: Multimedia and Internet Technologies
programmes.about: Images, video and audio together with programming, graphic design and internet technology, for people who like both mathematics and art.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, English 30% and motivation letter 30%.

programmes.name: Sustainable Engineering
programmes.about: Digital engineering for biological systems: production technologies, robots and drones, combining engineering with computer science and environmental care.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is maths 40%, English 30% and motivation letter 30%.

programmes.name: Music Production
programmes.about: Sound recording and design, music marketing and music technology, with creative projects of your own and the link between sound and visuals.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is a written test 50%, portfolio 30% and an interview 20%.

programmes.name: Performing Arts
programmes.about: Classical and jazz performance as a soloist, ensemble musician or conductor, with music history and theory, pedagogy and research at the VMU Music Academy.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is an entrance exam and video recording 70% plus an interview 30%; English at B1 is also asked.
programmes.ib: Audition by entrance exam and video recording; English at B1.

programmes.name: Sports Studies (in Kaunas)
programmes.about: Coach education for all sports, based on the American Sport Education Program, with modern training methods and technologies.
programmes.selectionNote: Score is sports achievements and motivation interview 40%, your school-grade average 40% and English 20%.

notes: EU/EFTA citizens pay a lower fee than other students (for example €3,250 against €3,400); it is the standard fee set by the Lithuanian ministry, and you pay the full first year in one instalment after you are accepted.
Applications for the 2027-28 autumn intake open in the beginning of November 2026, and studies start on 23 August 2027 (preliminary); the 2027 rules are still to be published.
Accounting and Finance is left out: its first year is taught in Ukrainian or Russian. Biology and Genetics and Biotechnology are marked as having state-funded places.
